title: Course Model v1
description: The versioned data contract between the ingestion pipeline and the Semester OS app surface. Every extracted course model must conform to this schema.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number per course. Supersedes previous model.

supersedes_id.description: model_id of the previous version this one replaces, or null if first version

syllabus_id.description: FK to syllabi.id — which syllabus produced this model

status.description: draft = not yet verified; verified = checks passed, awaiting human; approved = human approved; superseded = replaced by newer version

items.description: The extracted model items (deadlines, grades, policies, milestones, notes)

budget.description: Computed grade budget from grade_component items

verification_summary.description: Aggregate verification scores across all items

kind.description: deadline = date-bound deliverable (assignment, quiz, exam); grade_component = graded item with weight; policy = course rule (attendance, late penalty, etc.); milestone = non-graded date marker (midterm week, add/drop); note = general syllabus information

title.description: Human-readable item title, e.g. 'Midterm Exam', 'Assignment 3', 'Attendance Policy'

detail.description: Expanded description or policy text. For deadlines: scope/topics. For policies: full rule text.

session_no.description: LUMS session number (1-based) from the syllabus. Resolved to date via the sessions table at model-build time. null if not session-anchored.

date.description: Resolved calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) after model build. null during extract stage; resolved in step 5.

weight.description: Percentage weight for grade_components. null for non-grade items. All grade_component weights must sum to 100 (or be flagged).

tier.description: sourced = directly quoted/copied from syllabus text; synthesized = inferred by LLM from multiple syllabus passages. sourced items are higher confidence.

anchors.description: Citations back to the source syllabus. Every item must have at least one anchor.

approved.description: Human approval status. Items are not included in briefings or budgets until approved.

source_text.description: The exact text from the syllabus that this item was extracted from

page.description: Page number in the source PDF/docx

char_offset.description: Character offset in the extracted markdown chunk

score.description: Aggregate confidence score (0-1). Items below 0.5 are auto-rejected.

anchor_exists.description: At least one anchor's source_text is found verbatim in the parsed syllabus

number_match.description: If the item contains numbers (weights, scores, dates), they match the source text exactly

session_date_consistent.description: If session_no is set, it maps to a valid date in the sessions table for this term

llm_judge.description: LLM round-trip check: does the item accurately represent the source?

auto_rejected.description: true if score < 0.5 and item was auto-rejected without human review

total_weight.description: Sum of all grade_component weights. Should equal 100.

status.description: balanced = sum is 100; over = sum > 100 (error); under = sum < 100 (missing components)

scored.description: User-entered score (0-weight scale). null if not yet graded.

passed.description: Items with score >= 0.5 and all deterministic checks passing

failed.description: Items with score < 0.5 or deterministic check failure

coverage_pct.description: Percentage of syllabus sections that produced at least one model item. Minimum threshold: 60%.
